name: Remote response
requirement: Every valid test input shall produce its defined correct visible result at every required recipient within 100 ms, including timing uncertainty.
verification: Input-to-photon trace per input and recipient

name: Transmit ceiling
requirement: Each client shall charge at most 200000 transmitted bits in every rolling 1000 ms window, summed across recipients, retries and forwarded copies.

name: Application format
requirement: Every participant application exchange shall be a CoT event. XML 2.0 is the initial profile; any TAK binary form requires explicit negotiation and detail-preservation tests.

name: Serverless operation
requirement: No dedicated application server, cloud service or global simulation sequencer shall be required for ordinary owner-authored state.

name: Local operation
requirement: Both navigation estimators shall continue at 1000 Hz. Peer loss or backpressure shall not pace local estimation or the 90 Hz renderer.
verification: Local task and render deadline logs

name: Display integration
requirement: Retain PCB 1 CM5, PCB 2 navigation, PCB 3 HDMI capture, ROG XREAL R1 and 1280 by 720 per eye at 90 Hz. Local physical motion-to-photon shall remain at most 20 ms.

name: Input processing
requirement: Input onset to an event ready for scheduling shall be at most 10 ms in this profile, including headset return transport when present.

name: Urgent service
requirement: A pending urgent event and its next two copies shall have eligible starts no more than 1000/90 ms apart, including first-slot wait, arbitration and byte admission.

name: Successful delivery
requirement: A successful attempt shall publish authenticated decoded data at the recipient within 20 ms of its encoding start.

name: Display allowance
requirement: Publication to the first correct visible effect in the specified eye and test region shall be at most 30 ms.

name: Timing uncertainty
requirement: Use at most 1 ms as a conservative added bound on input-to-photon timing uncertainty; do not add it twice.

name: Loss bursts
requirement: Qualify loss of the first one or two urgent copies, with the next copy delivered within NET-009 and all other allocations met.

name: Event retention
requirement: Retries shall preserve the event ID. Receivers shall apply each operation at most once. State coalescing shall not erase discrete events.

name: Authority
requirement: Only authorized owners and epochs may update an entity. A disconnect shall not transfer ownership. Preserve tombstones and observation provenance.

name: Bounded work
requirement: Declare byte and entry capacities for queues, histories, parser inputs and repair. Overflow shall be logged; rejected required inputs count as deadline failures.

name: Physical feasibility
requirement: All transmit and receive operations shall obey the modeled MAC, interference, half-duplex, video, ranging and guard constraints.

name: Complete denominator
requirement: Freeze required recipients at input onset. Keep every valid offered input in the result, including late, rejected, missing and outage-affected inputs.

name: Scaling
requirement: Report the passing participant and activity envelope. Test populations are sweep points, not a project participant-count cap.
